note: A6.2b: `this.<field>.m()` parses as a member_expression whose object is itself a member_expression, so TypeScript member dispatch is always a ComplexReceiver{receiver: "this.<field>"}. It binds only through A6.2a's receiver-type pass, fed by the TS parser recording each field's declared type from three sources: constructor parameters (AppComponent), a typed class field and an `inject(T)` initialiser behind the `inject` import gate (AuditPanel). AdminService is @Injectable (its SERVICE overlay folds into the CLASS, LB.3a) and carries a decoy fetchUser: the field's declared type decides the target, not the method name.
